نستتيب (form X)
# نَسْتَتِيبُ (nastatību) /nas.ta.tiː.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
# نَسْتَتِيبَ (nastatība) /nas.ta.tiː.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَتَابَ (istatāba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
